note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for PL-400, 'Skills measured as of March 19, 2026'. This is the first six-domain exam in the catalogue: five domains share a 10-15% band and one carries 30-35%, so the paper is 8 questions in each of the five and 20 in 'Extend the platform'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Create a technical design
subtopics: Analyse technical architecture to identify solution components and their implementation approach
Design the authentication and authorisation strategy for solution components
Determine whether requirements can be met with out-of-the-box functionality
Determine where to implement business logic across business rules, plug-ins, client script, and Power Automate
Determine when to use standard tables, virtual tables, elastic tables, or connectors
Assess the impact of DLP policies, security roles, teams, business units, and row sharing
Design reusable components including canvas components, code components, and client scripting
Design custom connectors, Power Fx functions, plug-ins, and custom APIs
Design inbound and outbound integrations using Dataverse and Azure

domains.name: Build Power Platform solutions
subtopics: Troubleshoot operational security issues
Configure Dataverse security roles to support code components using least privilege
Manage Microsoft Power Platform environments for development
Manage solution dependencies
Create and use environment variables
Manage solution layers
Implement and extend Power Platform Pipelines
Create CI/CD automations using Power Platform Build Tools

domains.name: Implement Power Apps improvements
subtopics: Implement complex Power Fx formulas and functions
Build reusable component libraries
Use Power Automate cloud flows to implement business logic from a canvas app
Troubleshoot canvas and model-driven app issues using Monitor and browser debugging tools
Optimise canvas app performance including pre-loading data and query delegation
Optimise model-driven app performance including forms and views

domains.name: Extend the user experience
subtopics: Build JavaScript code that targets the Client API object model
Determine the event handler registration approach
Create client scripting that targets the Dataverse Web API
Configure commands and buttons using Power Fx and JavaScript
Implement navigation to custom pages using the Client API
Demonstrate the use of the different PCF lifecycle events
Configure a code component manifest and implement component interfaces
Package, deploy, and consume a code component
Configure and use Device, Utility, and Web API features in component logic

domains.name: Extend the platform
subtopics: Demonstrate the use of the different event execution pipeline stages
Develop plug-ins that use the execution context and implement business logic
Implement Pre Images and Post Images to support plug-in logic
Perform operations in plug-ins by using the Organization service and optimise plug-in performance
Configure a Dataverse custom API message and register components with the Plug-in Registration Tool
Configure Dataverse business events
Create an Open API definition, implement authentication, and configure policy templates for custom connectors
Develop an Azure Function to be used in a custom connector and transform data
Perform operations with the Dataverse Web API and the Organization service
Implement API limit retry policies and optimise for concurrency, transactions, and bulk operations
Process long-running operations with Azure Functions and authenticate using managed identities
Configure cloud flow triggers, expressions, error handling, child flows, and Key Vault usage

domains.name: Develop integrations
subtopics: Publish a Dataverse event by using the IServiceEndpointNotificationService
Publish a Dataverse event by using the Plug-in Registration Tool
Register service endpoints including webhooks, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Event Hub
Recommend options for listening to Dataverse events
Perform data synchronisation by using change tracking
Develop code that uses alternate keys
Use the UpsertRequest message to synchronise data
